question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**propounded**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence refers to an event that happened centuries ago, indicating past tense.
 
• The verb "**propounded**" is the correct past tense form, meaning to put forward an idea or theory for consideration.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Propounds" is the present tense form, which does not fit the past time frame.
 
• "Propound" is the base form of the verb, which is incorrect in this context.
 
• "Has propounded" is in the present perfect tense, which suggests a connection to the present, making it inappropriate for an event that occurred centuries ago.
